mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate applied to future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the direction of the relationship reverses (positive) in more than 40% of the sample.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates a weakening labor market and reduced consumer spending power, which depresses corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 5.0% and the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, the combined effect of monetary tightening and labor market weakness amplifies equity market stress, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * UNRATE) does not significantly predict returns (p>0.05) in a regression, or the negative returns occur in less than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (defined by strong GDP growth and robust housing starts), the S&P 500 exhibits negative 20-day forward returns due to profit-taking and anticipation of economic slowdown, with the effect being most pronounced when both GDPC1 growth and HOUST are above their 5-year moving averages.
failure_condition: The negative returns are observed in less than 60% of instances where the regime is active (GDPC1 and HOUST above thresholds), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (2017=100), it signals a contraction in the real economy, reducing corporate profitability and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 100, the 20-day forward returns are positive, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) fall below 350 million (in nominal terms), it indicates a significant drop in consumer spending, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS < 350, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with lower S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days (approximately one quarter) due to prolonged compression of equity valuations from elevated discount rates.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 60-day forward returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the relationship reverses direction in more than 40% of the sample.

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) falls below 135 million, it indicates a significant slowdown in job creation, reducing consumer confidence and spending, which results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS < 135000, the 5-day forward returns are positive, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
